verdict.rationale: Reflect has no native rules engine. The only user-configurable event-to-action path is the external Zapier integration, which connects Reflect to other apps; the API and deep links can append to notes, so Reflect can serve as an action target. Its built-in automations (Kindle sync, bookmarks and transcriptions added to the daily note) are fixed behaviors, not user-defined rules. Missing for 10: a native rule/trigger builder, documented Reflect-side event triggers or webhooks, details of Zapier triggers vs. actions, and independent corroboration.
